verdict.rationale: Aleph documents its own scenario modeling and versioned forecasts (aleph-docs-3), headcount planning backed by HRIS/ATS data (aleph-docs-4), and logic to run calculations and store metrics (aleph-docs-20). Together these suggest assumption-driven planning, but nothing explicitly describes driver-based models instead of hard-coded rows, and much of the modeling appears to live in connected Excel/Sheets workbooks (aleph-docs-1, aleph-docs-2). Missing for 10: explicit driver-based modeling documentation, growth-rate and price-point driver support, evidence that hiring assumptions flow into the forecast as drivers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
